plugins.name: humanizer-voice
plugins.description: Learns the user's writing voice with deterministic tools, rewrites copy in it via /voice, and gates delivery quietly. Use when the user says: '/voice polish this post', 'make this sound like me', 'humanize this draft before it ships'.

plugins.name: decision-advisor
plugins.description: Meta-cognitive decision analysis for one-way doors: expand options, contract to the elegant solution, embed enforcement. Use when the user says: 'decide whether to...', 'run a meta-decision on...', 'stress-test this decision'.

plugins.name: uxr-plugin
plugins.description: UX research operations for Claude Code: study tickets, specs, recruitment, interview scripts, reports, and decks. Use when the user says: 'recruit participants for my study', 'draft the interview script', 'write the research report'.
